title: Playlet Inventory Generator: snapshot-to-runbook converter for support automation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: Build an automated converter that takes live system inventory snapshots (service state, recent alerts, top traces, and config pointers) and synthesizes a runnable 'playlet' (a compact runbook-as-task) suitable for ingestion into the ops task runtime. The generator should produce idempotent steps, typed inputs, minimal rollback guidance, and telemetry hooks so the resulting playlets can be executed safely by first-line support or automated remediation pipelines.
technical_approach: 1) Define a normalized snapshot schema (YAML/JSON) that captures service topology, recent SLO breaches, implicated traces, and authenticated run context. 2) Implement transformation rules to map snapshot fragments to playlet primitives (checks, read-only probes, conditional remediations, and guarded mutation steps). 3) Embed observability probes and tracer span IDs in playlets so executions correlate to the originating snapshot and dashboard. 4) Provide a preview/validation mode that performs a dry-run against a staging environment and emits safety proofs (idempotency hints, permission scopes). 5) Expose an ingestion API so Console and the Admin CLI can create task entries from generated playlets.
acceptance_criteria: Generator accepts standard snapshot JSON and returns a playlet MAR (manifest) that passes the playlet schema validator
Playlets include telemetry bindings that surface execution -> originating-snapshot correlation in Console traces
Dry-run mode exercises mutating steps as no-ops and reports safety proofs; at least 5 staged snapshots validated in CI
Admin CLI can create a Linear ticket with the generated playlet attached and mark it as Ready for Execution
Automated canary execution in staging successfully remediates an injected SLO breach without escalations

T3: Implement playlet validator and dry-run harness (owner: Sofia Ruiz)
T4: Integrate telemetry bindings and Console correlation surface (owner: Liam O'Connor)
T5: Build ingestion API and Admin CLI hook to create tasks from generated playlets (owner: Priya Nair)
T6: Add end-to-end tests including staged canary remediations and CI gating (owner: QA)
T7: Create docs and runbook for SREs on how to author custom snapshot mappings (owner: Design)
notes: Decision: prefer a single stable playlet schema v1.0.0 for initial rollout to simplify Console integration
Tradeoff: embedding full trace contexts increases payload size; we will reference tracer ids and minimal trace snippets instead
Safety: mutating steps must be guarded by a two-phase opt-in flag and scope-limited IAM tokens
Related work: this complements the 'telemetry-led autofixlets' initiative and will reuse parts of the caching layer for snapshot deduplication
